questions.q: How can a tool process files without uploading them?
questions.a: SafeTools uses WebAssembly (WASM) and high-performance JavaScript to run the processing logic directly in your browser. When you 'upload' a file, it's actually just being loaded into your local browser RAM.

Yes. Because the code runs on your hardware, no data packets containing your file content are ever sent to a remote server. You can verify this by checking your browser's 'Network' tab while using any tool.

questions.q: What are the file size limits?
questions.a: Technically, there are no limits imposed by SafeTools. The only limit is your device's available RAM and your browser's memory allocation capacity.

questions.q: Does it work on mobile devices?
questions.a: Absolutely. SafeTools is fully responsive and many tools are optimized for mobile silicon, providing a professional experience on the go.
